title: Unscanned work cells are unchanged
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, let $O$ be an oracle language, and let $c$ be a configuration with $k+1$ work tapes. For any tape index $i$ and integer cell position $z$ different from the head position on tape $i$ in $c$, the content of cell $z$ on that tape is unchanged after one step of $M$ relative to $O$.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes
A tape index $i$ among the $k+1$ tapes
The cell position $z$ differs from the head position on tape $i$
replaced:
Let $M$ be an oracle machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, $O$ an oracle
language, $c$ a configuration, $i$ one of the $k+1$ work-tape indices, and $z$
an integer cell position different from the position of the $i$-th work head
in $c$.  Then after one step of $M$ relative to $O$, the content of cell $z$
of the $i$-th work tape is unchanged.
